environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. JWT authentication middleware validates token signature but does not enforce document-level authorization. Service runs with IAM role granting read access to all S3 document buckets. No API gateway policies restrict cross-tenant access patterns. ALB forwards all authenticated requests directly to the service.

config.network: ALB -> ECS direct, no API Gateway
config.storage: S3 with broad IAM read policy
